parameters.content:
## Recruiter Reply Classifier & Responder
Watches your inbox. For each new email, AI classifies it (INTERVIEW_INVITE,
WALKIN_DETAILS, REQUEST_FOR_DOCS, REJECTION, MORE_INFO_NEEDED, NOT_RECRUITER).
For recruiter emails it creates a Gmail DRAFT reply (never sent) and emails you a
summary for approval. Non-recruiter emails are ignored. Nothing is auto-sent.
